topics.name: Immigration and the multicultural society / aspects of political life

connections.why: Social change and political/artistic culture together describe a society in transition
Changes in society include the demographic and cultural shift brought by immigration
Political life and the arts are deeply shaped by immigration and multiculturalism
Set texts and films dramatise the social changes studied in the first theme
Many set works engage directly with political conflict and artistic movements
Immigration, identity and marginalisation are recurring themes in the set texts and films
Close literary-analysis skills transfer directly to the independent research project
Multicultural and political topics make rich, well-resourced subjects for independent research
Social-change themes give learners a familiar starting point for choosing their research topic
Cultural and political themes provide focused angles for the research-project discussion
